rules.logic: ABIOC(NDR-008 Periodic Low-and-Slow Beacon Deviating from Host Egress Baseline) AND ABIOC(NDR-008 Jittered Beacon to Rare Destination With Non-Standard Port Deviation) — fuses the two auto-tuned network behavioral deviations for the same source host into a single low-and-slow C2 beacon incident anchored to the host egress causality chain, surviving destination/IP rotation that defeats any static IOC.
rules.name: Low-and-Slow C2 Beacon Behavioral Anomaly — ABIOC Causality Stitch
